				location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_long_watch_lighthouse value >= 2 }
			}
		}
		NOT = {
			any_owned_location = {
				OR = {
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_eternal_lighthouse value >= 3 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_navigator_lighthouse value >= 3 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_long_watch_lighthouse value >= 3 }

			}
		}
	}

	naval_range = 400
